cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll start the village singalong. We said this concert would bring everyone together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The power's out. Nobody can hear you at the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring the back rows forward. I'll lead without a microphone; we can hear one another this way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half of them have gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then hold the first song. You meet them at the door; I'll make room up front for our new lighting crew.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads with village togetherness; A3 changes seating and amplification; A5 delays start and recruits B to welcome audience as lighting crew.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 unheard back rows cause A3 closeness; B4 torch errand causes A5 waiting and a new participant role.

relationship.evidence: B2 practical audibility and B4 missing people require actual coordination changes.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the original togetherness hope from shared singing into villagers supplying the show, using B4 offered solution.

specificity.evidence: A1 concert, B2 outage, B4 temporary torch errand and A5 door welcome establish clear timing.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 stop, meet and make-room clauses divide necessary tasks; new lighting crew is a direct invitation rather than an explanation.
